# Channel:direction

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.0</span></div>

Get / Set the direction of the channel (1 is normal / -1 reverse)

```lua
local direction = channel:direction([direction])
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `direction` | integer | optional |  |

## Returns
